name: Litecoin
rootCause: In March and April 2026, Litecoin's Mimblewimble Extension Block (MWEB) validation bug enabled fraudulent LTC creation and triggered a rare chain reorganization. The inflation event was fully contained on Litecoin and all tainted funds were recovered, but several cross-chain protocols,most notably NEAR Intents,credited swaps from the invalid branch, resulting in unreconciled exposures of up to 11,000 LTC. No end-user loss occurred on Litecoin itself, but third-party losses remain under review. The block connection logic in Litecoin's MWEB implementation failed to enforce full input metadata validation, allowing miners to construct blocks with mismatched metadata and inflate peg-outs.…
